spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut, torn, divided.
E.
दो to cut, affix क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 One of the wives of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the Daityas or infernal race, opposed to the gods.
2 Cutting, splitting, dividing.
m. (-तिः)
A king, a prince.
E.
दो to cut, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-जः)
An Asura, a sort of Titan or giant.
E.
दिति as above, and ज born.

m. (-तः)
A Titan or giant.
E.
दिति as above, and सुत a son.

m. (-त्यः)
A Titan, a demon or giant.
E.
दिति as above, अण् affix; and the vowel unchanged: see दौत्य.

f. (-त्सा)
Desire or purpose to give.
E.
दा to give, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing to give.
E.
दा to give, desid. form, aff.
